new_hypothesis.name: jito_tip_floor_regime_signal
new_hypothesis.mechanism: Jito's bundle tip distribution is a market-wide aggregate of how aggressively MEV searchers are bidding for transaction priority. On Solana, outside of obvious arb windows (which are a constant baseline), large tip-floor spikes overwhelmingly reflect coordinated buy bundles competing to be first into a single fresh-mint listing or graduation. The p99/ema_p50 ratio (right now ~159) captures the tail's distance from the median: when it sustains >200 for 2+ consecutive minute-polls, the market is paying outsized priority fees for one specific opportunity, and that opportunity is almost always a memecoin launch/grad window. The signal is REGIME-LEVEL not per-token — but it tells the bot WHEN opportunities exist before token-level scanners (which gate on DexScreener data) see anything.
new_hypothesis.persistence: Every existing token-side bot (DexScreener pollers, pump.fun listeners, our own brain) watches the TOKEN'S metrics (volume, holders, age). Jito tip-floor is the BLOCK-ECONOMICS metric — orthogonal data with no overlap. Searchers running bundles cannot avoid emitting this signal because the tips are how they buy block position; the signal is structurally unhideable. Free public endpoint with 1 req/sec ceiling and no auth means the data is open, but nobody on the consumption side correlates it to memecoin entry timing because that crosses a discipline boundary (block-engineers don't run memecoin bots).
new_hypothesis.entry_rules: Phase 1 (LOG-ONLY, 7 days): poll https://bundles.jito.wtf/api/v1/bundles/tip_floor every 60s, write {timestamp, landed_tips_50th, landed_tips_99th, ema_landed_tips_50th, ratio_p99_over_ema_p50} to sol_jito_tipfloor_log.json (ring buffer 10080 entries = 7 days @ 1/min). No entry behavior changes in Phase 1. Phase 2 (regime modifier): when ratio_p99_over_ema_p50 > 200 sustained ≥2 consecutive polls, set bot regime flag JITO_MEV_STORM=True for 5 minutes. In MEV_STORM mode: (a) tighten time-stop on fresh-mint entries from 30min → 10min (acknowledge the regime is fast-flowing), (b) relax m5_activity_floor by 25% on fresh-mint strategies (more opportunities are flowing through), (c) log every entry that fires during MEV_STORM to sol_jito_storm_entries.json for backtest. Phase 3 (per-token attribution, optional): scrape explorer.jito.wtf/bundle/<id> HTML to identify the specific pool the bundle targets, raising signal from regime → per-token. Out of scope for v1.
new_hypothesis.data_required: 1 line of Python: requests.get('https://bundles.jito.wtf/api/v1/bundles/tip_floor', timeout=5). No auth, no key, no rate-limit concern (1req/sec ceiling vs 1req/min usage = 60x headroom). Single shipped poller thread, ring buffer file with atomic writes. No code dependency beyond what the bot already has.
new_hypothesis.evidence: Subagent live-tested endpoint at 2026-05-19 16:39 UTC. Response 200 OK, valid JSON, payload {landed_tips_50th_percentile: 2.5e-6, landed_tips_99th_percentile: 0.000412, ema_landed_tips_50th_percentile: 2.59e-6} — current ratio 159x. Citations: (a) DeFade 'Bundle Sniping on Solana' documents ~400ms same-slot coordinated buy windows on pump.fun launches; (b) SolBundler/Alphecca tooling shows the entire memecoin launch industry routes through Jito bundles; (c) Jito JSON-RPC spec confirms public endpoint inventory. Conceptual mechanism: tip is a Veblen-style positional good — competitive overbidding only happens when multiple actors converge on the same target. Cross-validation against pump.fun launch density would convert this from circumstantial to predictive — proposed as Phase 1 logging objective.

(b) Jito WS tip_stream — kept as Phase-2 upgrade once minute-poll regime trigger is validated. (c) Helius webhooks for whale movements — rejected for THIS run because Helius is paid above free tier and competes with the next research run's bandwidth; flagging as a separate scout target for next-run-focus. (d) Scraping explorer.jito.wtf for per-bundle target attribution — moved to Phase 3 because it's HTML scraping (brittle); regime signal is sufficient for v1.
